offering_description.value: Operates a self-service cloud-based demand-side platform that lets advertising agencies and brands plan, buy, and measure digital ad campaigns across channels such as connected TV, display, video, audio and mobile. It delivers the platform as software and takes a fee on ad spend.

primary_products.value: demand-side advertising platform; connected TV ad buying software; advertising data and identity tools; ad measurement and optimization software

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertising agencies, agency holding companies and brand advertisers

end_markets.value: digital advertising; media and entertainment; retail and consumer goods; automotive; financial services

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: platform fee as a percentage of advertising spend managed through the platform; service fees: data and add-on fees for premium features and managed services
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: technology platform connecting advertisers' buying demand to publishers' ad inventory and data sources

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific, with the majority of activity in North America

specialization.value: niche specialist: single programmatic ad-buying platform spanning channels, with related data and measurement tools

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving agencies and brands directly, with self-service platform access

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and consumer tracking rules such as GDPR, CCPA and state privacy laws, plus FTC oversight
